title: Pinned external quality holdout through the validated serial exact-token primitive
scope: A supplemental native Arm64 evaluation of the selected Ministral 3 3B Q4_K_M model and the nearest Q4_0 control on the three E9b tasks and samples selected before results. It recreates lm-evaluation-harness v0.4.12 request construction and metrics, but uses the E10b exact-token probability primitive because the standard local-completions echo path and the E10c forked scorer failed their frozen native gates.
hypothesis: The admitted Q4_K_M model preserves defensible external multiple-choice robustness on the independently pinned ARC Easy, HellaSwag, and WinoGrande subsets, and its per-task accuracy is not materially worse than the nearest Q4_0 control. No minimum score is required and every poor or mixed outcome is retained.

harness.known_server_difference: v0.4.12 auto-detection requires /tokenizer_info, which llama.cpp b10216 does not expose; the preflight therefore supplies a pinned local tokenizer snapshot only after proving its token IDs equal llama.cpp /tokenize output.

tokenizer.parity_requirement: Every predefined UTF-8, punctuation, contraction, task-format, and answer-prefix probe must produce exactly the same token IDs through the pinned tokenizer and llama.cpp /tokenize.

task_provenance.license_source: Hugging Face dataset-card metadata at the pinned revision

workload.sample_selection: The exact E9b salted SHA-256 selection map, chosen before any task outcome.

scoring.mechanism: For each choice, submit the full frozen prompt with cache_prompt=false for its first target token; for every later target token, submit the explicitly growing target prefix with cache_prompt=true. Each request asks the validated E10b probability_ids primitive for exactly the current target token's raw pre-sampling log probability. Candidate starts never reuse another candidate's cache.
scoring.harness_relationship: Pinned lm-evaluation-harness v0.4.12 constructs tasks, chat-template strings, token boundaries, left truncation, gold labels, and choice-length normalization. The custom serial adapter replaces only the standard OpenAI echo/logprobs transport that failed E9b preflight.
scoring.prediction_rule: Argmax of summed target-token log probabilities, with first choice winning an exact tie.
scoring.normalized_prediction_rule: Argmax of sum log probability divided by the pinned harness character length of the choice, with first choice winning an exact tie.
scoring.raw_response_retention: Every one of the 14,374 HTTP scoring responses per model is retained gzip-compressed with compressed and uncompressed SHA-256 and byte counts.

preflight_parameters.cache_prompt_policy: false on the first token of each candidate; true on later tokens

probe_parameters.cache_prompt_policy: false for the first token of every candidate; true only for later tokens of that candidate
probe_parameters.score_distribution: raw pre-sampling selected token log probability

negative_result_rule: Retain low accuracy, Q4_K_M regressions against Q4_0, task-specific disagreement, preparation failure, tokenizer mismatch, API failure, cache-policy mismatch, raw-response loss, dataset/provenance failure, build failure, or incomplete jobs without changing tasks, sample indices, models, metrics, scoring rule, or gates.

decision.promotion_claim: Supplemental robustness evidence only; this experiment cannot replace the original 30-task admission contract.

prior_blockers.standard_harness_api: E9b native run 30766707967 failed before external outcomes because llama.cpp b10216 rejects the echo=true local-completions request required for continuation log probabilities.
prior_blockers.forked_candidate_scorer: E10c native run 30812791972 failed all three frozen numerical-parity gates despite passing prediction and efficiency gates; it is not used here.
prior_blockers.validated_path: E10b native run 30797568757 passed 1e-6 exact-token log-probability parity and promoted probability_ids for a separately frozen multi-token evaluator.

claim_boundary: E10d is supplemental external multiple-choice robustness evidence for two exact Ministral 3 3B quantizations, three pinned task subsets, lm-evaluation-harness v0.4.12 request construction and metrics, the validated serial exact-token adapter, and the exact E7c one-slot native Arm64 service plus E10b response primitive. It is not a successful standard harness OpenAI-backend claim, does not rewrite the original 30-task admission contract, and makes no energy, PMU, local-device, fleet, concurrency, cost, causal, or other-runtime claim.
